hints.title: Right Greater Value Removal
hints.text: Every node whose value is strictly less than any subsequent node in the list must be removed.

hints.title: Reverse Traversal or Monotonic Buffer
hints.text: Traversing the list in reverse allows maintaining the maximum value seen so far. Any node with value smaller than this maximum is pruned.

hints.title: Monotonic Stack Technique
hints.text: Traverse nodes and push to a non-increasing collection. Pop any items strictly smaller than the current node value.

hints.title: Monotonic Stack Reconstruction Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in linked list
complexity.notes: Each node is pushed and popped at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the remaining list forward for each node requires quadratic O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for node buffer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes monotonic decreasing property and reconstructs the chain cleanly.
